name: Borehole Hall
schemaNote: See docs/kano.md 5.2 to 5.5. Hall x runs 0 to width, floor at groundY. Rusty Borehole is an old pump and tank (a problem, never a person) standing from body[0] to body[1]; he never moves and is a wall to the hero (rightLimit). valves.x are the middles of three round valve wheels on his pipe and valves.bottom their lowest y; the stuck one shakes and wears the STUCK tag, in valves.x order. A head bump from below on the stuck valve is a hit. Under each valve stands a springy cloth frame (the Kofar Mata frame). Each cough is warned by a wheeze; a whirl rolls from whirl.fromX toward the hero and puffs apart at the left wall; a gust (from phase 2) cuts air speed toward him to gust.airScale for gust.lasts s, warned gust.warn s before. holdBreath: no new whirl leaves him from a cloth bounce until the hero's feet touch the floor (a cloth again does not count); a whirl due then waits at his mouth, wheezing, and leaves heldWhirlDelay s after the hero lands. whirl.clearGap (KN-R15): a whirl never appears touching the hero; while the hero's box is within clearGap u of the whirl's box at his mouth, a whirl due waits there, wheezing, and leaves heldWhirlDelay s after the hero is clear. valveNeedsWhirl (KN-R14): the next valve is shut tight (tagged WAIT, a head bump only goes clonk) until that phase's first whirl has left him, then it shakes loose (STUCK) and stays ready for the phase; after waitHintAfter s of bouncing while it says WAIT, one hint a try. phases[0] is before any hit; one phase per valve, so 3 valves win. gentle numbers replace the normal ones in Gentle mode (5 lives there, as every hall).
